title: FIX-AUDIT [N7]: substitute message-payload construction stays shape-exempt from the hooks lint — its gate is code-review-only
evidence:
client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:1053-1055: "event.on_click(msg.UserChoseRefcheckAction(
              call.reference_call_id,
              RefcheckSubstitute,
            ))" — reachable only via line 1029 "case call.hooks.can_substitute_referee {". scripts/lint_refcheck_hooks.py:146: "# `(` call arg / `{` import / top-level: exempt by shape"; :134-135: "inner = stack[-1][0] if stack else ""
            if inner == "[":"
detail: The lint only inspects tokens whose innermost bracket is `[`. The substitute constructor passes as a call argument, so this construction site remains invisible to CI regardless of any hook gate. Unchanged from r1.
recommended_fix: Extend the lint to require UserChoseRefcheckAction take-over/substitute payloads to sit lexically inside the matching hooks gate, or move the construction below the gate into the gated list shape.

title: trigger.is_terminal now decodes through status_from_string, whose terminal Failed fallback frees the slot for unknown status strings
detail: Previously an unrecognised status string was not in the list, so the row occupied its slot. Now it decodes to Failed (terminal), so in an expand-then-contract window a v2 live status frees the slot and permits a duplicate row.
recommended_fix: Guard the unknown case: treat only the eight known terminal strings as terminal for slot liveness, or explicitly document that unknown statuses deliberately free the slot.

title: Lockstep direction 2 iterates a hardcoded 14-string copy, so a new shared terminal status omitted from the server const fails nothing
evidence:
application_detail_handler_test.gleam:589-595: "...in BOTH directions: every const entry is a
status the shared fn calls terminal, and every status string the shared
fn calls terminal is IN the const."; :608-627: "let all_status_strings = [
    \"queued\",
    ...
    \"failed\",
  ]
  list.each(all_status_strings, fn(s) {...". server/src/application/application_detail_handler.gleam:1465: "let terminal_entries = case list.contains(terminal_statuses, status) {".
detail: The test's claim is false beyond the 14 listed strings. A future shared enum variant marked terminal but missing from terminal_statuses is never checked, so the timeline silently omits its terminal entry — the mirror-drift class AR-RC13 names.
recommended_fix: Derive direction 2 from a shared-exported status list (e.g. an all_status_strings helper beside the enum) instead of a hardcoded test-local copy.

title: Hooks lint still evadable: qualified constructor tokens and bare-argument construction in parens bypass the gate check
detail: TOKEN_RE joins dotted names into one token, so `model.RefcheckTakeOver` never matches HOOK_FOR; and any constructor whose innermost bracket is `(` (e.g. `list.prepend(RefcheckTakeOver, menu)`) is exempt even outside every hooks gate.
recommended_fix: Match HOOK_FOR on the token's trailing segment after the last dot, and only exempt paren-args when an enclosing hooks gate of the matching name exists.

title: Em-dash lint's SERVER_INCLUDE omits applicant-facing inline strings in application_handler, document_download_page, and document_upload
evidence:
scripts/lint_em_dash.py:42-56: "SERVER_INCLUDE = [
    \"server/src/copy.gleam\",
    \"server/src/application/application_detail_handler.gleam\",
    ...
    \"server/src/reference_checks/result.gleam\",
]". server/src/application/application_handler.gleam:284: "\"\" -> [#(\"first_name\", \"We need your first name to continue\"), ..errors]". server/src/application/document_download_page.gleam:20-23: "page_title: \"File not found | RightTenantry\", ... body: \"It may have been removed...\"".
detail: These modules render applicant-facing prose (validation errors, page copy) but are neither in SERVER_INCLUDE nor copy consts scanned by tests. A future em-dash in them ships unscanned, like the N2 gap this lint was built to close.
recommended_fix: Add the three modules (or the whole server/src/application and reference_checks trees) to SERVER_INCLUDE, or move their prose into scanned copy consts.
